title: PolicyRuleSchema
description: Schema representing a single deterministic campus screening policy rule.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy rule (e.g. RULE-TOBACCO-01)

action.description: Screening outcome mandated when this rule matches

min_quantity.description: Minimum inclusive quantity threshold, if rule is quantity-dependent

max_quantity.description: Maximum inclusive quantity threshold, if rule is quantity-dependent

quantity_unit.description: Required unit of measure for quantity threshold matching (e.g. PACK, KG), if applicable

platform.description: Specific delivery platform (e.g. ZOMATO, BLINKIT), or null for all platforms

priority.description: Evaluation priority: lower integer means higher precedence (e.g. 10 > 50 > 100)

policy_version.description: Version string of the policy ruleset (e.g. v1.0, draft-1)

effective_from.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when rule becomes active

effective_to.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when rule expires

active.description: True if rule is active; soft-deactivation sets to false

description.description: Human-readable administrative rationale for this rule
